fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: fighter module creation allocates 0xe0 bytes, stores vtable 0x7104f88028 and the boma, then the pointer at boma+0x198

fields.name: owner (BattleObjectModuleAccessor)
fields.evidence: constructor; methods reach ModelModule (boma+0x78), LinkModule (boma+0xd0), WorkModule (boma+0x50) and the owner id (u32 at boma+0x8)

fields.name: ink_map.buckets
fields.evidence: ink / set_ink / add_ink compute bucket = id % bucket_count (or & (n-1) when a power of two) and load (+0x10)[bucket]; reset (f_710046d460) and slot 0x28 zero every bucket

fields.name: ink_map.bucket_count
fields.evidence: same functions use it as the modulus

fields.name: ink_map.first_node (singly linked, 0x18-byte nodes)
fields.evidence: ink(0x50000000 = all) and add_ink walk the list from +0x20 via node+0x0; reset frees every node and zeroes +0x20

fields.name: ink_map.size
fields.evidence: reset / slot 0x28 test it before clearing; constructor 0

fields.name: ink_map.max_load_factor (1.0)
fields.evidence: constructor stores 1.0f at +0x30; set_ink / add_ink read it when inserting

fields.name: node.painter_id (node +0x10)
fields.evidence: ink / set_ink compare node+0x10 with the resolved object id; add_ink picks the node with the largest ink and takes its +0x10 as last painter

fields.name: node.ink (node +0x14)
fields.evidence: ink(id) returns node+0x14 of that id; ink(0x50000000) sums node+0x14 over all nodes above a small epsilon; set_ink stores the clamped value into node+0x14 (or into every node when id is 'all')

fields.name: last_paint_color
fields.evidence: add_ink stores the painter's color at +0x40; get_ink_color falls back to +0x40/+0x50; slot 0x28 resets +0x40 and +0x50 to the global zero vector (w=0)

fields.name: last_paint_color_2
fields.evidence: get_ink_color reads +0x50; slot 0x48 (update) writes it

fields.name: last_painter_id
fields.evidence: add_ink stores the resolved painter id; slot 0xc8 returns it; slot 0xc0 sets it; slot 0x28 zeroes it

fields.name: ink_total (cached)
fields.evidence: add_ink and set_ink store the new total at +0x68; slot 0xa0 returns it; reset_ink (via f_710046d460) zeroes it; per-frame slot 0x48 decays/rewrites it

fields.name: special_paint[0].active
fields.evidence: base set_special_paint (f_710046da40, also called first by the fighter override) sets +0x70 = 1; get_ink_color returns record 0's color when +0x70 is set

fields.name: special_paint[0].color
fields.evidence: set_special_paint loads a param (hash 0x132f102b61) color (or 1,1,1) and stores (r,g,b,0) at +0x80; get_ink_color returns this+0x80 (record 0) when +0x70

fields.name: special_paint[0].alpha (1.0)
fields.evidence: set_special_paint stores 1.0 at +0x90

fields.name: special_paint[0].param (hash 0x1275d6a98a)
fields.evidence: set_special_paint stores a common param float at +0x94

fields.name: special_paint[0].id
fields.evidence: set_special_paint stores a value at +0x98; slot 0x48 decrements u32 +0x98 (timer)

fields.name: special_paint[1].active
fields.evidence: fighter set_special_paint (f_71006cba60) sets +0xa0 = 1 when the painter is a valid fighter and ink is 0, then requests WorkModule (boma+0x50) slot 0x98 with 0x10000042; get_ink_color returns this+0xb0 when +0xa0

fields.name: special_paint[1].color
fields.evidence: get_ink_color index 1: this+0x80+0x30

fields.name: special_paint[1].timer
fields.evidence: slot 0x48 decrements u32 +0xc8

fields.name: disabled
fields.evidence: add_ink, set_ink and set_special_paint return immediately when set; slot 0xc0-adjacent setter f_710046db90 sets it to 1; slot 0x28 clears it

pointers.to: hash bucket array (bucket_count entries of 8 bytes)
node list: next +0x0, hash +0x8, painter id u32 +0x10, ink f32 +0x14

notes: Two 224-byte classes share all slots except destructors, reset_ink (0x80), slot 0x50, slot 0xa8 and set_special_paint (0xb8): 0x7104f88028 is the fighter's (constructed in the fighter module-creation function, stored at boma+0x198); its set_special_paint first calls the base one then may fill the second record. reset_ink = clear map and total (f_710046d460, which also calls slot 0x78 set_ink(0, all)) then ModelModule slot 0x250. ink_max is not a field: it reads a common param (hash 0x0d633f3ad4). ink(id): id 0x50000000 means all painters. Painter ids are resolved by f_710046dba0 (object id -> owner/team object, invalid 0x50000000). No exported getter is a plain module load, so all fields are probable.
